metadata.purpose: Hand-curated candidate wallets for the COPY bot. Validated by scripts/curate_wallet_pool.py against Cielo's /trading-stats endpoint, then filtered into wallet_pool.json.
discovery_sources: X/Twitter alpha accounts public wallet posts
Hyperliquid leaderboard (we already curated for STRUCTURE)
metadata.format: Each entry: { address, chain ('solana'|'base'|'arbitrum'), note (free-form, e.g. source attribution) }
instructions: Two ways to populate the candidate set:
A) Hand-seed: add wallets to the seeds array below, then:
docker compose exec framework python -m scripts.curate_wallet_pool --dry-run
B) Birdeye discovery + hand-seeds (recommended for quarterly refresh):
docker compose exec framework python -m scripts.curate_wallet_pool --from-birdeye 100 --dry-run
Both candidate sources merge + dedup before validation.
Review pass/reject. If satisfied: --apply to overwrite wallet_pool.json.
Commit + push wallet_pool.json so Hetzner picks it up on next pull.
